title: Interstellar Impact
description:
Discord Community

Об игре

Every replay is different, every change or direction creates a random new set of threats around the player. Nothing is the same, and nothing is predictable.

 

Enter "Endless Mode" to hunt the biggest high score. 

And remember, do not collide with "The World Killer". Any collision with him is game over.

Starting as an innocent asteroid your goal is to evolve and progress to larger stages. Collide with smaller asteroids and evolve to the planet stage.

As you grow and become the source of all light in the universe your journey is not over. Do not hit any larger objects until you are pulled into a black hole.
description_short: Stylized single player adventure survival game. Explore the vastness of space, collide with smaller objects, avoid larger ones, grow until you are pulled into a black hole.
